title.narrative: Activity under preparation EU BlueGate Caribbean

description.narrative: The Action would facilitate EU private sector investments in port modernisation and maritime transport and shipping services development, with particular focus on digitalisation, security and the greening of the sector, notably after the postponement of the ¿Net-Zero Framework¿ at IMO which was strongly supported by the EU and Caribbean SIDs. It will target the whole Caribbean region (EUR 8M), with a specific national window of support for Guyana (EUR 1.5 million), Suriname (EUR 2 million) and Jamaica (EUR 5 million) funded through their respective bilateral envelopes.The action intends to contribute to the maritime connectivity regional Global Gateway priority, and it is fully in line with the objectives of the Caribbean Window of the MIP for Americas. The Overall Objective of this action is to promote sustainable economic growth and regional integration in the Caribbean by enhancing regional maritime connectivity, under a Global Gateway approach.The Specific Objectives of this action are: enhance the capacity, efficiency and decarbonisation of port operations and develop smart and green port infrastructure through EU public and private sector participation, knowledge and investments. foster efficiency, security and accessibility of maritime transport services under a Global Gateway approach.
